description: Draws the board as text, one cell per hole with column and row numbers: each part's pins by a key letter and pin number (a1, a2...), holes under a part's body, wire ends, the holes a wire runs over without joining them, strip cuts and holes with notes. Below it, which part each key is and every wire with its ends and net. Use it to see where there's free space and how wires run before placing parts or routing more. With format "png", a picture of the board as the editor draws it instead, to see how it looks: parts' bodies and where they reach, labels, wire colours. To show the user the board, use show_board.

area.description: Only this part of the board: two opposite corner holes. The whole board when left out.

format.description: "text" (default): the board as text. "png": a picture of it, 50 px per hole, scaled down to fit 1000 px.

project.description: The whole project file (through version 8), or its JSON text (see perfboard://docs/project-file). Give this or projectId. Preserve instanceId and optional requirements fields.

projectId.description: The id of a project kept here (from new_project, validate_project, edit_project or read_share_link), instead of sending the whole project.

name: render_board
title: Render board
